articles.event_key: 国家发展和改革委员会|发布|“十五五”交通与消费目标
articles.title: 发改委发布“十五五”交通与消费目标
articles.summary: 国家发展改革委发布会提出新建约15个民用运输机场、2030年交通网主骨架建成率95%、十五五末社零约60万亿元。
articles.new_facts: 发改委发布会提出“十五五”新建约15个民用运输机场、2030年主骨架建成率95%、十五五末社零约60万亿元。
entities: 国家发展和改革委员会|National Development and Reform Commission
articles.limitations: 目标来自发改委发布会，由中新网转述；未直接取得发布会原文或正式规划文件。

facts.text: 据中新网报道，国家发展改革委11月4日举行“奋进‘十五五’”发布会，提出“十五五”时期新建约15个民用运输机场，打造以北京、上海、广州、深圳、成都、重庆为中心的世界级机场群。

evidence.quote: “十五五”时期，我国将新建约15个民用运输机场
以北京、上海、广州、深圳、成都、重庆为中心，打造主辅协同、功能互补、客货兼顾的世界级机场群

facts.text: 基础设施发展司司长夏鑫称，力争到2030年国家综合立体交通网主骨架建成率达到95%，重点风险路段和桥梁监测预警设施全覆盖，完成约2000座铁路危旧桥梁加固改造。

evidence.quote: 力争到2030年国家综合立体交通网主骨架建成率达到95%
力争到2030年重点风险路段和桥梁监测预警设施100%全覆盖，完成约2000座铁路危旧桥梁加固改造整治

facts.text: 经济贸易司副司长寇荣称，预计“十五五”末社会消费品零售总额达到60万亿元左右。

evidence.quote: 社会消费品零售总额达到60万亿元左右

bilingual.title_en: NDRC Releases Transport and Consumption Targets for 15th Five-Year Plan

sentences.en: According to China News Service, the National Development and Reform Commission held a press conference on November 4 under the theme "Striving for the 15th Five-Year Plan," proposing the construction of about 15 new civil transport airports during the 15th Five-Year Plan period and the creation of world-class airport clusters centered on Beijing, Shanghai, Guangzhou, Shenzhen, Chengdu, and Chongqing.
sentences.zh: 据中新网报道，国家发展改革委11月4日举行“奋进‘十五五’”发布会，提出“十五五”时期新建约15个民用运输机场，打造以北京、上海、广州、深圳、成都、重庆为中心的世界级机场群。

sentences.en: Xia Xin, director of the Department of Infrastructure Development, said that efforts will be made to raise the completion rate of the main skeleton of the national comprehensive transport network to 95 percent by 2030, achieve full coverage of monitoring and early-warning facilities for key risk sections and bridges, and complete the reinforcement and renovation of about 2,000 old and unsafe railway bridges.
sentences.zh: 基础设施发展司司长夏鑫称，力争到2030年国家综合立体交通网主骨架建成率达到95%，重点风险路段和桥梁监测预警设施全覆盖，完成约2000座铁路危旧桥梁加固改造。

sentences.en: Kou Rong, deputy director of the Department of Economic and Trade, said that total retail sales of consumer goods are expected to reach about 60 trillion yuan by the end of the 15th Five-Year Plan period.
sentences.zh: 经济贸易司副司长寇荣称，预计“十五五”末社会消费品零售总额达到60万亿元左右。

articles.title: 媒体预测民主党将翻转美国众议院
articles.summary: BBC和《卫报》预测民主党将在中期选举中翻转众议院，尚未见官方最终计票。
articles.new_facts: BBC和《卫报》预测民主党将翻转众议院；尚未见官方最终计票。
entities: 美国众议院|US House of Representatives
articles.limitations: 两家媒体均为预测，非官方计票；未给出已确认席位总数。

facts.text: 据BBC和《卫报》报道，美国中期选举预测显示，民主党将翻转众议院，从共和党多数变为民主党多数。《卫报》称，在特朗普执政两年后，民主党有望赢得众议院。上述为媒体预测，不是官方最终计票结果。

evidence.quote: Democrats are projected to flip the House of Representatives from a Republican majority to a Democratic one.
Democrats poised to flip House in midterm elections after two turbulent years of Trump

sentences.en: According to BBC and The Guardian, projections for the U.S. midterm elections show that Democrats will flip the House, turning a Republican majority into a Democratic majority.
sentences.zh: 据BBC和《卫报》报道，美国中期选举预测显示，民主党将翻转众议院，从共和党多数变为民主党多数。

sentences.en: The Guardian said that after two years of Trump in office, Democrats are expected to win the House.
sentences.zh: 《卫报》称，在特朗普执政两年后，民主党有望赢得众议院。

articles.event_key: 西班牙交通大臣奥斯卡·普恩特|辞职|马德里附近列车相撞事故
articles.title: 西班牙交通大臣因高铁相撞事故辞职
articles.summary: 普恩特在造成至少69人死亡的高铁事故六天后辞职，并退出11月29日提前大选。
articles.new_facts: 普恩特在事故六天后辞职并退出提前大选；事故至少69死；1月同一线路事故46死。
entities: 西班牙交通部|Ministry of Transport of Spain
articles.limitations: 发布时间原文仅显示3 November 2026，具体时分来自搜索索引；事故原因仍在调查，死亡数字为BBC报道。

facts.text: 西班牙交通大臣奥斯卡·普恩特11月3日晚在国会宣布辞职，并称将退出11月29日提前大选。此前六天，马德里以南乌尔达附近发生高速列车相撞事故，至少69人死亡、数十人受伤。

evidence.quote: He announced his decision in Congress, after giving evidence on last Wednesday's disaster near the town of Urda, south of the capital Madrid, in which a train smashed into the back of a stationary train.
Puente announced his decision at the end of a lengthy congressional session on Tuesday evening in which he had outlined new rail safety measures and had been grilled by the opposition.
Spain's Transport Minister Óscar Puente has resigned - six days after the high-speed train collision in which at least 69 people were killed and dozens injured.
I am also withdrawing my name from the lists for the early legislative elections.
with early general elections on 29 November.

facts.text: 普恩特称，在不到一年发生两起严重事故后，他不能继续任职；他指的是1月同一线路造成46人死亡的事故。首相桑切斯称赞他面对局势、提供答案和解决方案后让位。

evidence.quote: A transport minister in a country like Spain cannot remain in office after two accidents of this seriousness in less than a year
a reference to January's crash on the same line which left 46 people dead
The prime minister praised his colleague who had "faced up to the situation, provided answers and solutions, and then stepped aside".

facts.text: 事故涉及Renfe一列载397人的列车与Iryo一列静止列车，后者载147人；有报道称自动信号系统计算机故障曾迫使受影响路段所有列车停运。反对党人民党和Vox此前要求普恩特辞职。

evidence.quote: Last Wednesday's accident involved a train run by state-owned operator Renfe with 397 passengers on board and a stationary train run by private operator Iryo, which was carrying 147 passengers.
A reported issue with the automatic signalling system - a computer failure - had forced all trains to halt on the affected stretch.
The main opposition, the conservative People's Party (PP) and the far-right Vox, were both calling for his resignation

bilingual.title_en: Spain's transport minister resigns over high-speed train collision

sentences.en: Spain's transport minister, Oscar Puente, announced his resignation in Congress on the evening of November 3 and said he would withdraw from the snap election on November 29.
sentences.zh: 西班牙交通大臣奥斯卡·普恩特11月3日晚在国会宣布辞职，并称将退出11月29日提前大选。

sentences.en: Six days earlier, a high-speed train collision near Urda, south of Madrid, killed at least 69 people and injured dozens.
sentences.zh: 此前六天，马德里以南乌尔达附近发生高速列车相撞事故，至少69人死亡、数十人受伤。

sentences.en: Puente said he could not continue in office after two serious accidents in less than a year, referring to a January accident on the same line that killed 46 people.
sentences.zh: 普恩特称，在不到一年发生两起严重事故后，他不能继续任职；他指的是1月同一线路造成46人死亡的事故。

sentences.en: Prime Minister Sánchez praised him for stepping down after he confronted the situation and offered answers and solutions.
sentences.zh: 首相桑切斯称赞他面对局势、提供答案和解决方案后让位。

sentences.en: The accident involved a Renfe train carrying 397 people and a stationary Iryo train carrying 147; reports said a computer failure in the automatic signalling system had forced all trains on the affected section to stop running.
sentences.zh: 事故涉及Renfe一列载397人的列车与Iryo一列静止列车，后者载147人；有报道称自动信号系统计算机故障曾迫使受影响路段所有列车停运。

sentences.en: The opposition People's Party and Vox had demanded Puente's resignation.

articles.event_key: 英国与欧盟|达成|食品出口脱欧繁文缛节草案协议
articles.title: 英国与欧盟就取消食品出口脱欧检查达成草案协议
articles.summary: 英国与欧盟达成食品农产品出口检查草案协议，尚待正式签署和峰会确认。
articles.new_facts: 英国与欧盟达成取消食品出口脱欧检查的200页草案协议，已分发欧盟国家审议；协议尚未正式签署。
articles.limitations: 协议为草案，尚未正式签署；发布时间原文仅显示3 November 2026，具体时分来自搜索索引；政府收益为官方评估。

facts.text: 据BBC报道，英国与欧盟已就取消食品和农产品出口脱欧检查达成草案协议，200页文本已分发欧盟国家，供周三会议审议。该协议被视为英国“脱欧重置”迄今最重要部分，但尚未正式签署。

evidence.quote: The UK and EU have agreed a draft deal on removing post-Brexit checks from food and agriculture exports, ahead of the UK-EU summit later this month.
the 200-page draft text for this so called "SPS" [sanitary and phytosanitary] agreement has been circulated to EU nations in Brussels for consideration at a meeting on Wednesday.
The food deal is the most significant part of the so-called Brexit reset agreed so far

facts.text: 协议拟允许向欧盟出口鲜香肠、汉堡、贝类、种薯等，取消200英镑出口健康证书和25英镑植物检疫证书等要求，并恢复英国宠物进入欧盟的宠物护照。作为交换，英国预计承诺动态对齐欧盟植物、动物和食品贸易标准。

evidence.quote: Exports to the EU of fresh sausages, burgers, shellfish from domestic waters and seed potatoes would be able to resume
It should remove the need for £200 Export Health Certificates
It should also end the need for £25 Phytosanitary certificates
It will bring back passports for British pets being taken into the EU
the UK is expected to commit to observing and adapting to existing EU regulations on plant, animal and food trade standards - a process called "dynamic alignment".

facts.text: 英国政府称协议最终每年带来51亿英镑收益，首相称可额外提升GDP最多0.4%。这些是政府评估，协议仍需峰会确认。

evidence.quote: the government claims the UK economy will eventually see £5.1bn worth of annual benefits
the prime minister said a UK-EU deal could add up to 0.4% extra on GDP.

bilingual.title_en: UK and EU Reach Draft Deal to Scrap Brexit Checks on Food Exports

sentences.en: According to the BBC, the UK and EU have reached a draft agreement to remove Brexit checks on food and agricultural exports, and a 200-page text has been distributed to EU countries for consideration at a meeting on Wednesday.
sentences.zh: 据BBC报道，英国与欧盟已就取消食品和农产品出口脱欧检查达成草案协议，200页文本已分发欧盟国家，供周三会议审议。

sentences.en: The agreement is seen as the most important part so far of the UK's 'Brexit reset,' but it has not yet been formally signed.
sentences.zh: 该协议被视为英国“脱欧重置”迄今最重要部分，但尚未正式签署。

sentences.en: The agreement would allow exports to the EU of fresh sausages, burgers, shellfish, seed potatoes and other products, remove requirements such as the £200 export health certificate and the £25 phytosanitary certificate, and restore pet passports for UK pets entering the EU.
sentences.zh: 协议拟允许向欧盟出口鲜香肠、汉堡、贝类、种薯等，取消200英镑出口健康证书和25英镑植物检疫证书等要求，并恢复英国宠物进入欧盟的宠物护照。

sentences.en: In exchange, the UK is expected to commit to dynamic alignment with EU standards for trade in plants, animals and food.
sentences.zh: 作为交换，英国预计承诺动态对齐欧盟植物、动物和食品贸易标准。

sentences.en: The UK government says the agreement will ultimately bring £5.1 billion in benefits each year, and the prime minister says it could boost GDP by up to an additional 0.4%.
sentences.zh: 英国政府称协议最终每年带来51亿英镑收益，首相称可额外提升GDP最多0.4%。

sentences.en: These are government assessments, and the agreement still needs confirmation at a summit.
sentences.zh: 这些是政府评估，协议仍需峰会确认。

articles.event_key: 美国|空袭|伊朗格什姆岛
articles.title: 伊朗革命卫队称击落美军无人机，美伊继续经调解方接触
articles.summary: 美方称打击格什姆岛后，伊朗革命卫队称击落美军无人机；卡塔尔称美伊正在审阅调解方案。
articles.new_facts: 伊朗革命卫队称击落两架MQM-170和一架MQ-9；卡塔尔称双方审阅提案；此前历史已报道美方打击格什姆岛。
articles.limitations: 美方打击细节来自美国官员向CBS转述，美军未置评；伊朗革命卫队战果为其单方面主张。

facts.text: 在美方称对伊朗格什姆岛实施有限防御性打击后，伊朗伊斯兰革命卫队称，其部队在格什姆岛以南击落两架美军MQM-170无人机，在霍尔木兹海峡以东击落一架美军MQ-9无人机。美军未就打击置评。

evidence.quote: The US has carried out strikes on Iran's Qeshm Island in the Strait of Hormuz, US officials have told CBS, the BBC's US partner.
its forces had shot down two US MQM-170 drones south of the island and a US MQ-9 drone east of the Strait of Hormuz.
The US military has not commented on the strikes

facts.text: 卡塔尔外交部发言人安萨里11月3日称，美伊双方正在审阅调解方提出的设想和方案，双方仍致力于谈判进程。伊朗谈判代表卡利巴夫称，“球现在在美国一边”，但没有说明具体所指。

evidence.quote: Qatar's foreign ministry spokesman said on Tuesday that both sides were "reviewing the ideas and proposals we have presented" and that it remained hopeful of a deal being agreed.
Iran's chief negotiator with the US, parliament speaker Mohammad Bagher Ghalibaf, stated: "The ball is now in America's court to prevent war."
It was not immediately clear what Ghalibaf was referring to

bilingual.title_en: IRGC Says It Downed US Drones as US and Iran Continue Contacts Through Mediators

sentences.en: After the US said it carried out limited defensive strikes on Iran's Qeshm Island, Iran's Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps said its forces shot down two US military MQM-170 drones south of Qeshm Island and one US military MQ-9 drone east of the Strait of Hormuz.
sentences.zh: 在美方称对伊朗格什姆岛实施有限防御性打击后，伊朗伊斯兰革命卫队称，其部队在格什姆岛以南击落两架美军MQM-170无人机，在霍尔木兹海峡以东击落一架美军MQ-9无人机。

sentences.en: The US military did not comment on the strikes.
sentences.zh: 美军未就打击置评。

sentences.en: Qatari Foreign Ministry spokesperson Al-Ansari said on November 3 that the United States and Iran are reviewing ideas and proposals put forward by mediators, and that both sides remain committed to the negotiation process.
sentences.zh: 卡塔尔外交部发言人安萨里11月3日称，美伊双方正在审阅调解方提出的设想和方案，双方仍致力于谈判进程。

sentences.en: Iranian negotiator Ghalibaf said, "The ball is now in the US court," but did not specify what he was referring to.
sentences.zh: 伊朗谈判代表卡利巴夫称，“球现在在美国一边”，但没有说明具体所指。

articles.event_key: 巴西参议院|通过|公共安全宪法修正案
articles.title: 巴西参议院通过公共安全宪法修正案
articles.summary: 巴西参议院两轮一致通过公共安全宪法修正案，降低刑责年龄议题被分离另行审议。
articles.new_facts: 参议院两轮一致通过公共安全宪法修正案；未纳入降低刑责年龄；相关修正案以38比36分离。
entities: 公共安全宪法修正案|PEC da Segurança Pública
articles.limitations: 报道来自巴西通讯社；修正案尚待颁布，降低刑责年龄议题另行审议。

facts.text: 巴西参议院11月3日晚两轮投票通过公共安全宪法修正案，首轮73票赞成、0票反对，次轮75票赞成、0票反对。该修正案由联邦政府提出，将提交国会颁布。

evidence.quote: O plenário do Senado Federal aprovou na noite desta terça-feira (3), em dois turnos, a Proposta de Emenda à Constituição (PEC) da Segurança Pública
com 73 votos favoráveis e nenhum contrário, em primeiro turno. No segundo turno, o placar foi de 75 votos favoráveis e nenhum contrário.
De autoria do Poder Executivo
o texto será promulgado pelo Congresso Nacional.

facts.text: 修正案将单一公共安全系统写入宪法，加强对犯罪集团和民兵头目的刑罚和特别监禁制度，允许设立受检察院外部监督的市政民事警察，并规定国家公共安全基金和监狱基金的一半资源转拨给州和市。

evidence.quote: a constitucionalização do Sistema Único de Segurança Pública (SUSP)
A PEC estabelece penas mais duras e regimes especiais de prisão para os chefes de facções e milícias
a possibilidade de criação de polícias municipais de natureza civil, submetidas ao controle externo do Ministério Público
50% dos recursos do Fundo Nacional de Segurança Pública (FNSP) e do Fundo Penitenciário Nacional (Funpen) serão repassados pela União para os estados e municípios

facts.text: 参议院未将降低刑事责任年龄的修正案纳入正文，相关修正案以38比36的投票结果被分离，将另行审议。参议员罗热里奥·卡瓦略称，这些议题与修正案打击有组织犯罪的核心目标不同。

evidence.quote: Por um placar apertado de 38 a 36, o requerimento do relator para separar as emendas em outro projeto foi aprovado.

As matérias tratadas nas emendas são relevantes e merecem ser debatidas por essa Casa. Não se confundem, contudo, com o objetivo central da PEC 18/2025, voltado ao combate ao crime organizado e à reestruturação da governança federativa da segurança pública

bilingual.title_en: Brazil Senate Passes Public Security Constitutional Amendment

sentences.en: Brazil's Senate passed the public security constitutional amendment in two rounds of voting on the evening of November 3, with 73 votes in favor and 0 against in the first round and 75 in favor and 0 against in the second.
sentences.zh: 巴西参议院11月3日晚两轮投票通过公共安全宪法修正案，首轮73票赞成、0票反对，次轮75票赞成、0票反对。

sentences.en: The amendment was proposed by the federal government and will be submitted to Congress for promulgation.
sentences.zh: 该修正案由联邦政府提出，将提交国会颁布。

sentences.en: The amendment enshrines the Unified Public Security System in the Constitution, strengthens penalties and the special imprisonment regime for leaders of criminal groups and militias, allows the creation of municipal civil police subject to external oversight by the Public Prosecutor's Office, and stipulates that half of the resources of the National Public Security Fund and the Prison Fund be transferred to states and municipalities.
sentences.zh: 修正案将单一公共安全系统写入宪法，加强对犯罪集团和民兵头目的刑罚和特别监禁制度，允许设立受检察院外部监督的市政民事警察，并规定国家公共安全基金和监狱基金的一半资源转拨给州和市。

sentences.en: The Senate did not incorporate into the main text the amendment lowering the age of criminal responsibility; that amendment was separated by a 38-36 vote and will be considered separately.
sentences.zh: 参议院未将降低刑事责任年龄的修正案纳入正文，相关修正案以38比36的投票结果被分离，将另行审议。

sentences.en: Senator Rogério Carvalho said these issues are different from the amendment's core objective of combating organized crime.
sentences.zh: 参议员罗热里奥·卡瓦略称，这些议题与修正案打击有组织犯罪的核心目标不同。

articles.event_key: 美国总统特朗普|决定|将卢旺达和南非移出美国贸易优惠安排
articles.title: 特朗普计划将南非和卢旺达移出AGOA贸易优惠
articles.summary: 特朗普通知国会计划从2027年起将南非和卢旺达移出AGOA，美方称两国不符合资格要求。
articles.new_facts: 特朗普通知国会计划2027年1月1日起将南非和卢旺达移出AGOA；美国贸易代表称年度审查发现不符合资格；南非称不幸。
articles.limitations: 计划从2027年1月1日生效；报道基于BBC，美方公告未直接取得；具体影响为报道引述的数据。

facts.text: 据BBC报道，美国总统特朗普已通知国会，计划从2027年1月1日起将南非和卢旺达移出《非洲增长与机会法案》贸易优惠安排。美国贸易代表格里尔称，年度审查发现两国做法不符合该计划资格要求。

evidence.quote: US President Donald Trump has notified Congress of his intention to remove South Africa and Rwanda from a preferential trade programme, from 1 January 2027.
US Trade Representative Jamieson Greer said in a statement that an annual review had found that both countries were engaging in practices inconsistent with the programme's eligibility requirements.

facts.text: 美方对南非提出腐败、贸易投资壁垒以及国际安全和外交关系担忧；对卢旺达提出人权、政治多元化、法治和劳工权利问题。南非贸易部长陶称这一决定“不幸”，表示将加快出口市场多元化。

evidence.quote: For South Africa, the US pointed to corruption.
In Rwanda's case, Washington also raised concerns about human rights, political pluralism, the rule of law and workers' rights.
South Africa's Trade Minister Parks Tau described the decision as "unfortunate"
We will continue to accelerate the diversification of South Africa's export markets to protect jobs

facts.text: 报道称，南非2025年享受AGOA优惠的出口约17亿美元，低于前一年的40亿美元；卢旺达对美出口约4330万美元。该决定距美国财政部制裁卢旺达国防部不到一周。

evidence.quote: The value of South African exports under the programme fell to about $1.7bn (£1.3bn) in 2025, from $4bn the previous year
Rwanda saw its exports to the US rise to $43.3 million in 2025
The move comes barely a week after Rwanda's defence ministry was hit with sanctions by US Treasury

bilingual.title_en: Trump Plans to Remove South Africa and Rwanda from AGOA Trade Preferences

sentences.en: According to BBC, US President Donald Trump has notified Congress that he plans to remove South Africa and Rwanda from the African Growth and Opportunity Act (AGOA) trade preference arrangement starting January 1, 2027.
sentences.zh: 据BBC报道，美国总统特朗普已通知国会，计划从2027年1月1日起将南非和卢旺达移出《非洲增长与机会法案》贸易优惠安排。

sentences.en: US Trade Representative Greer said the annual review found that the two countries' practices did not meet the program's eligibility requirements.
sentences.zh: 美国贸易代表格里尔称，年度审查发现两国做法不符合该计划资格要求。

sentences.en: The United States raised concerns about South Africa regarding corruption, trade and investment barriers, and international security and diplomatic relations, and about Rwanda regarding human rights, political pluralism, the rule of law and labor rights.
sentences.zh: 美方对南非提出腐败、贸易投资壁垒以及国际安全和外交关系担忧；对卢旺达提出人权、政治多元化、法治和劳工权利问题。

sentences.en: South African Trade Minister Tau called the decision "unfortunate" and said it would accelerate the diversification of export markets.
sentences.zh: 南非贸易部长陶称这一决定“不幸”，表示将加快出口市场多元化。

sentences.en: The report said South Africa's exports benefiting from AGOA preferences were about $1.7 billion in 2025, down from $4 billion the previous year, while Rwanda's exports to the United States were about $43.3 million.
sentences.zh: 报道称，南非2025年享受AGOA优惠的出口约17亿美元，低于前一年的40亿美元；卢旺达对美出口约4330万美元。

sentences.en: The decision came less than a week after the US Treasury Department sanctioned Rwanda's Ministry of Defence.
sentences.zh: 该决定距美国财政部制裁卢旺达国防部不到一周。
